messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: Sentinel Health showing unexpected token burn spike. Preparing a short cost slide for their QBR on Thu. Need quick triage and a one-paragraph mitigation to include in the customer note.
Rafael (CSM): Noted. I saw the dashboard — spike started 03/03 around 02:10 UTC. Their client team ran a weekly reingest job.
Iris (FinOps): Cost slice: embeddings + rerank routes are responsible for ~75% of the delta. If sustained this weeks rate, projected monthly overrun ~USD 8.6k.
Tom (SE): Can you paste the top routes/token changes? I want to see if batch sizes or concurrency are off.
Maya (CS): quick heatmap excerpt:
```
route: /v1/embeddings/upload_bulk  tokens: +1.05M  calls: +4.1k  concurrent_jobs: 10
route: /v1/embeddings/query_batch  tokens: +210k   calls: +900   concurrent_jobs: 3
route: /v1/rerank/score          tokens: +60k    calls: +700   concurrent_jobs: 2
```
Rafael (CSM): Their team mentioned bumping batch size to 200 last sprint. Likely cause. I'll ask them to pause the reingest and revert to batch_size=64 for now.
Iris (FinOps): Suggested customer-facing mitigation paragraph: "We recommend pausing the reingest, revert batch_size to 64, and enable per-job token throttle. We'll provide a temporary credits buffer while you run the reduced job to avoid service disruption."
Tom (SE): Engineering recommendations: add tenant-level soft quotas for token/min, default SDK batch_size 64 for uploads, and enable prefix KV caching for common lookups. Low-effort PR + a migration note. I can draft the PR and include a one-line impact estimate (~30-45% reduction typical).
monitor-bot: automated alert: anomaly 2026-03-03T02:12Z for account Sentinel Health route /v1/embeddings/upload_bulk token-rate z=4.8. Alerting was in legacy-suppressed mode.
Maya (CS): Action items: Rafael -> send pause + buffer ask; Iris -> add slide with baseline vs spike and projected overrun; Tom -> PR + impact note; Maya -> schedule a 15-min pre-QBR run-through Mon.
Rafael (CSM): Draft customer note to review here before send.
Maya (CS): Thanks team. If any additional anomalies show up before EOD, post them here and I'll fold into the deck. :white_check_mark:
